props.title: Pause & Read
props.subtitle: Gentle impulses for more calm, a relaxed back and a good feeling in your own body – thoughts from my practice for your everyday life.

props.title: Want to feel it for yourself?
props.text: Words on a screen are one thing – breathing deeply on the mat is another. Arrive in a small, safe group, let the day fall away from you and find your way back to yourself. Just write to me, I look forward to meeting you.
